_help: Each run (08:00 and 20:00 Toronto) publishes the oldest due post, on or after its 'date' (YYYY-MM-DD, Toronto time); two posts on one date go out morning and evening. 'video' is an MP4 in social/videos/ (Instagram Reel), 'image' a JPEG in social/images/. 'platforms': any of facebook, instagram, story (Instagram Story), linkedin. Published ids are recorded in social/posted.json.

CRA scam alert: the CRA will never ask you to pay with gift cards. 🚩

Hang up and don't pay. Check a suspicious call, text or letter on ComplaintCA, and report scams to the Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre: 1-888-495-8501.

complaintca.ca

How to file a complaint in Canada — free, in 7 languages, with an anonymous option. 🍁

ComplaintCA takes your problem to the right authority in your province.

complaintca.ca

Filing a complaint in Canada in 3 steps:

1️⃣ Tell us what happened, in your own language
2️⃣ We match it to the right authority for your province
3️⃣ Send it and keep your reference number

complaintca.ca

Tenant rights: mould, no heat, repairs ignored? 🏚️

Every province has a tenancy board that can order your landlord to make repairs. Find yours on ComplaintCA.

complaintca.ca

Unpaid wages in Ontario? You generally have 2 years to file an Employment Standards claim with the Ministry of Labour — and it's free.

Other provinces have their own deadlines. Check yours on ComplaintCA.

complaintca.ca

Bank complaint denied? That's not the end. 🏦

✓ Banks must respond within 56 days
✓ Then you can go to OBSI — free and independent
✓ File with OBSI within 180 days of the bank's final answer

complaintca.ca

Discrimination at work, in housing or in services?

In Ontario, you must apply to the Human Rights Tribunal within one year of the last incident. Find the right body for your province on ComplaintCA.

complaintca.ca

File a complaint in your own language. 🌐

ComplaintCA works in English, Français, 中文, Español, العربية, ਪੰਜਾਬੀ and Türkçe.

complaintca.ca

Anonymous complaint? You can. 🔒

Report anonymously on ComplaintCA. Some bodies can't open a formal file without your identity — we tell you when, so you can decide.

complaintca.ca

Find your MP and MPP by postal code. 🏛️

Enter your postal code on ComplaintCA to find your federal and provincial representatives and contact them directly.
